verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents team comments: teammates can discuss an email privately inside the client, and @mentioning a teammate gives them access to the email itself. That is per-thread sharing, not a true shared inbox or shared account with common conversation state. One community user also notes it lacks Front-style multi-inbox. Missing for 10: documented shared or team inboxes, shared conversation state (done/assigned status visible to all), team channels that surface shared mail, and independent corroboration of team inbox workflows.
